change: Rebalance existing five-stage control without adding latency: IF prepares sequential prediction and stream adjacency through command/pending/FIFO; ID consumes those bits for dual admission and registers branch kind/bypass; EX separates ALU/address/permission, branch target/outcome, exception priority and recovery; MEM names per-lane completion and owns accepted slow requests; WB ordered retirement unchanged.

configuration.pnr: one default run,ctrl-chain4; no seed sweep

stream_metadata_proof: Commands are prepared in predicted program order: each next_pc is the previous prepared command final predicted-next-PC. Its first word is adjacent to the previous command last word iff that prior final prediction equals prior lastPC+4. Register this one-bit tail property on actual prepare only; carry each new command first-link and own per-word sequential flags through accepted/pending/FIFO. Internal second word always PC+4. Reset tail property on flush and drain old held/pending commands with existing sticky discard. Within a valid queue pair, stored link equals sidePC==mainPC+4 even across packets, wrap, partial pops and stalls. No wide tail-PC register or extra issue stage.

stage_allocation.IF: BTB, registered fetch command, response predecode and stream metadata; two extra bits per FIFO entry, one prepared-tail bit
stage_allocation.ID: Existing dependence/pairing/bypass selection plus prepared flags and two-bit registered B/JAL/JALR kind
stage_allocation.EX: Parallel data/AGU/permission/branch/system cones; combine one-bit fault/recovery decisions, preserve result availability and early RAM request edge
stage_allocation.MEM: Per-lane done predicates, accepted request state and grouped response holding; slow MMIO owned here
stage_allocation.WB: Original ordered main/side retirement, CSR/precise trap state, final multiply high-half path

references.idea: Separate branch target/outcome, recovery and branch-exception interfaces. Adapted in Verilog with original local trap priority, not a Vex transplant.
Command stage is configurable between execute and memory; preserve early local-RAM issue rather than adding a generic request stage and load-use latency.

verification_notes: Existing wide-PC primary/secondary admission equations retained independently in the SoC TB, while DUT admission now consumes metadata.
Independent EX-control oracle reproduces original selected-target alignment, exception cause priority, CSR/mret suppression and miss conditions.
Five necessary short runs, then one same-image CoreMark. No broad ISA sweep, no second candidate or seed sweep.
No primary-BRANCH/side-ALU pairing from Round49 retained, no predictor/capacity/LSU/config change.
limits: One cold one-iteration CoreMark diagnostic, not an official score.
One P&R implementation; STA Fmax includes placement variation, not a board result.
MEM/WB responsibilities already largely matched the target and are kept; this does not claim every long EX-to-RAM topology is removed.
No new global pipeline stage, deeper FIFO or added load-use/branch recovery cycle.
No production firmware, PLL/IP/constraints, bitstream, commit or push. Candidate remains local awaiting user decision.

analysis.behavior: One-iteration benchmark282211, stats window282245, total retired288072, main209592, side78480, whole simulation417298, issued/retired pairs113531/113212, dualLSU9746 and replay319 all exactly match accepted Round39. IF bubbles27594 and branch recoveries8981 unchanged. No result-availability, issue or refill cycle was added.
analysis.coverage: Five necessary short runs passed: IF FIFO full/held flush/pending flush/response flush/dual-pop/fault behavior plus prepared flags, and four existing hazard/trap/IRQ/side-branch/dualLSU/MUL programs under variable latency.
